title: Appeal: 616421

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

/report is used to tell mods about a player that may be using a hacked client.

You must of used /report in a manner where it does not help the mods.

It will not be appealed. You should read the rules.

Regards,
LegendaryEngram, Avicus Network Senior Mod.
